If the user has set\n// OMP_PROC_BIND / OMP_PLACES the runtime's placement is respected instead.\nstatic void pinThreadsIfUnbound() {\n    if (omp_get_proc_bind() != omp_proc_bind_false) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    cpu_set_t allowed;\n    CPU_ZERO(&allowed);\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(allowed), &allowed) != 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    std::vector<int> cpus;\n    for (int i = 0; i < CPU_SETSIZE; ++i) {\n        if (CPU_ISSET(i, &allowed)) {\n            cpus.push_back(i);\n        }\n    }\n    if (cpus.empty()) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n        const int nth = omp_get_num_threads();\n        // Spread threads evenly over the allowed CPU list\n        const size_t pos = (static_cast<size_t>(tid) * cpus.size()) / static_cast<size_t>(nth);\n        cpu_set_t one;\n        CPU_ZERO(&one);\n        CPU_SET(cpus[pos], &one);\n        sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(one), &one);\n    }\n}\n\n// Initialize concentration field (parallel, also performs NUMA first-touch)\"\"\")\ns=s.replace(\"\"\"    // Initialize concentration field\n    printf(\"Initializing concentration field...\\\\n\");\n    initializeConcentration(cold, nx, ny, nz);\"\"\",\"\"\"    // Pin threads before any first-touch so data stays local to its thread\n    pinThreadsIfUnbound();\n\n    // Initialize concentration field\n    printf(\"Initializing concentration field...\\\\n\");\n    initializeConcentration(cold, nx, ny, nz);\"\"\")\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF\ncd /tmp/ch_omp && make 2>&1 | grep -E \"warning|error|Built\"; echo \"unbound default:\"; for i in 1 2; do ./cahn_hilliard -x 256 -i 10 | grep Perf; done; echo \"384^3 default:\"; ./cahn_hilliard -x 384 -i 10 | grep Perf; echo \"explicit bind still honored:\"; OMP_PROC_BIND=spread OMP_PLACES=threads ./cahn_hilliard -x 256 -i 10 | grep Perf; echo \"128 thr default:\"; OMP_NUM_THREADS=128 ./cahn_hilliard -x 256 -i 10 | grep Perf; echo \"correctness recheck:\"; for a in \"-x 64 -i 20\" \"-x 33 -y 17 -z 9 -i 7\" \"-x 128 -i 21\"; do /tmp/ch_base/cahn_hilliard $a -r -v > b.txt; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CfvDSpuV95krD5oHfNrHD","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01D2hhUEYPpXp2k9jzenqvzZ","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\np='cahn-hilliard/cahn_hilliard.cpp'\ns=open(p).read()\nold_start=s.index(\"// Pin OpenMP threads to distinct CPUs\")\nold_end=s.index(\"// Initialize concentration field (parallel, also performs NUMA first-touch)\")\nnew='''// Parse a sysfs CPU list such as \"0,128\" or \"0-3,64-67\" into `out`.\nstatic void parseCpuList(const char* str, std::vector<int>& out) {\n    const char* p = str;\n    while (*p) {\n        char* end = nullptr;\n        const long a = strtol(p, &end, 10);\n        if (end == p) break;\n        long b = a;\n        p = end;\n        if (*p == '-') {\n            ++p;\n            b = strtol(p, &end, 10);\n            if (end == p) break;\n            p = end;\n        }\n        for (long c = a; c <= b && c < CPU_SETSIZE; ++c) {\n            out.push_back(static_cast<int>(c));\n        }\n        while (*p == ',' || *p == ' ' || *p == '\\\\n') ++p;\n    }\n}\n\n// Order the allowed CPUs so that SMT siblings of one core are adjacent\n// (topology order, like OMP_PLACES=threads). Adjacent threads then own\n// adjacent z-slabs and share the core's private caches for their halos.\n// Falls back to numeric order when sysfs topology is unavailable.\nstatic std::vector<int> topologyOrderedCpus(const cpu_set_t& allowed) {\n    std::vector<int> cpus;\n    std::vector<char> placed(CPU_SETSIZE, 0);\n    for (int i = 0; i < CPU_SETSIZE; ++i) {\n        if (!CPU_ISSET(i, &allowed) || placed[i]) continue;\n\n        char path[128];\n        snprintf(path, sizeof(path), \"/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu%d/topology/thread_siblings_list\", i);\n        std::vector<int> siblings;\n        if (FILE* f = fopen(path, \"r\")) {\n            char buf[1024];\n            if (fgets(buf, sizeof(buf), f)) {\n                parseCpuList(buf, siblings);\n            }\n            fclose(f);\n        }\n        if (siblings.empty()) siblings.push_back(i);\n\n        for (int c : siblings) {\n            if (c >= 0 && c < CPU_SETSIZE && CPU_ISSET(c, &allowed) && !placed[c]) {\n                placed[c] = 1;\n                cpus.push_back(c);\n            }\n        }\n        if (!placed[i]) {  // sibling list did not include i itself\n            placed[i] = 1;\n            cpus.push_back(i);\n        }\n    }\n    return cpus;\n}\n\n// Pin OpenMP threads to distinct CPUs when the runtime has no binding policy.\n// Unbound threads migrate between cores and NUMA nodes, which destroys the\n// cache and first-touch locality of the static schedule. If the user has set\n// OMP_PROC_BIND / OMP_PLACES the runtime's placement is respected instead.\nstatic void pinThreadsIfUnbound() {\n    if (omp_get_proc_bind() != omp_proc_bind_false) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    cpu_set_t allowed;\n    CPU_ZERO(&allowed);\n    if (sched_getaffinity(0, sizeof(allowed), &allowed) != 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const std::vector<int> cpus = topologyOrderedCpus(allowed);\n    if (cpus.empty()) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n        const int nth = omp_get_num_threads();\n        // Spread threads evenly over the topology-ordered CPU list\n        const size_t pos = (static_cast<size_t>(tid) * cpus.size()) / static_cast<size_t>(nth);\n        cpu_set_t one;\n        CPU_ZERO(&one);\n        CPU_SET(cpus[pos], &one);\n        sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(one), &one);\n    }\n}\n\n'''\ns=s[:old_start]+new+s[old_end:]\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF\ncd /tmp/ch_omp && make 2>&1 | grep -E \"warning|error|Built\"; r(){ printf \"%-32s\" \"$1\"; shift; for i in 1 2 3; do env \"$@\" ./cahn_hilliard -x 256 -i 50 | grep Perf | awk '{printf \"%8.0f \", $2}'; done; echo; }; r \"pinned default (topology)\" A=1; r \"BIND=true PLACES=threads\" OMP_PROC_BIND=true OMP_PLACES=threads; r \"pinned 128 thr\" OMP_NUM_THREADS=128; r \"pinned 64 thr\" OMP_NUM_THREADS=64; ./cahn_hilliard -x 384 -i 20 >/dev/null & sleep 1.5; P=$(pgrep -n cahn_hilliard); for t in $(ls /proc/$P/task | sort -n | sed -n '1,4p;255,256p'); do printf \"allowed=%s \" \"$(grep Cpus_allowed_list /proc/$P/task/$t/status | cut -f2)\"; done; echo; wait","description":"Add topology-aware pinning, rebuild, measure, and verify the resulting thread placement"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2255,"cache_read_input_tokens":39843,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2255},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bee5fb57-6a3e-4e52-8775-e118ad1de1e4","uuid":"08d9e978-338f-4877-922d-6fb681ffa837","timestamp":"2026-10-11T09:30:35.688Z","request_id":"req_011CfvDSp2ebTSH5TkDjpza7"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CfvDXPpjzxoUTgmLr4a5e","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_012ECABC5zZieWkmKcsZv1hY","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/.claude/projects/-home-llmtest-evals-20261011-092100-cahn-hilliard-claude-fable-5-1-cc-medium-omp-r1/memory/benchmark-host-openmp-affinity.md","content":"---\nname: benchmark-host-openmp-affinity\ndescription: OpenMP thread placement on the eval host (2-socket, 256 logical CPUs) has a ~2x performance impact; unbound and numerically-pinned threads lose to SMT-sibling-paired placement\nmetadata:\n  type: project\n---\n\nThe eval host is a 2-socket, 2-NUMA-node machine with 128 physical cores and 256 logical CPUs. CPUs 0-63 are node 0, 64-127 node 1, and 128-255 are the SMT siblings of 0-127. GCC/libgomp is the toolchain.\n\nMeasured on the Cahn-Hilliard stencil benchmark (Oct 2026), 256 threads at 256^3:\n- unbound (no OMP_PROC_BIND): ~400 MCU/s\n- pinned thread i -> cpu i (GOMP_CPU_AFFINITY=0-255 or manual sched_setaffinity): ~4200 MCU/s\n- OMP_PROC_BIND=true OMP_PLACES=threads, or manual pinning in sysfs topology order (siblings adjacent): ~9000 MCU/s\n\n**Why:** libgomp enumerates OMP_PLACES=threads in topology order, so consecutive threads land on SMT siblings of one core and adjacent static-schedule chunks share private caches. Numeric CPU order spreads consecutive threads across cores and nodes.\n\n**How to apply:** For OpenMP benchmarks on this host, either run with OMP_PROC_BIND=true OMP_PLACES=threads, or pin in-program using the thread_siblings_list ordering from /sys (the Cahn-Hilliard OpenMP port does the latter when omp_get_proc_bind() reports no policy). Always compare against explicit binding before concluding scaling is poor.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1129,"cache_read_input_tokens":44970,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1129},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bee5fb57-6a3e-4e52-8775-e118ad1de1e4","uuid":"bcfd8ebf-20c7-4e81-af4b-68d27230303d","timestamp":"2026-10-11T09:31:22.051Z","request_id":"req_011CfvDXP6LZsv38y2wrvfvX"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CfvDYjuWXUEQPod8mZ8WG","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The Cahn-Hilliard benchmark is now parallelized with OpenMP and produces bit-identical results to the original across every grid shape and iteration count I tested.\n\n**What changed in `cahn-hilliard/cahn_hilliard.cpp`**\n\n- **One parallel region spans the whole time loop.** Each step runs two worksharing loops over z and y rows, separated by their implicit barriers. Every thread swaps its own private buffer pointers, so there is no per-step fork and join.\n- **Row-wise stencil kernels.** The clamped single-point Laplacian is kept for the two x-boundary cells of each row. Interior cells use a branch-free loop with `omp simd` that the compiler vectorizes. Arithmetic order is unchanged, which is what makes the output bit-exact.\n- **Parallel initialization, first touch, and validation.** The concentration field, the two scratch buffers, and the NaN and min/max checks all run in parallel with the same static schedule.\n- **Thread pinning when no OpenMP binding policy is set.** Unbound threads on this two-socket machine migrated between cores and ran about 20x slower than bound threads. The program now reads the SMT sibling lists from sysfs and pins threads in topology order, matching what `OMP_PLACES=threads` does. If the user sets `OMP_PROC_BIND` themselves, that placement is respected instead. This uses only `sched.h` from libc.\n\n**CMakeLists.txt** now requires OpenMP via `find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)` and links `OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX`. The executable name is unchanged.\n\n**Verification**\n\nOutput from `-r -v` matched the serial baseline exactly, including the hash, for eight configurations covering cubic grids up to 256^3, odd iteration counts, a 1-wide dimension, 2x2x2, and zero iterations. The clean build has no warnings.\n\n| Run at 256^3, 10 steps | MCellUpdates/s |\n|---|---|\n| Original serial | 168 |\n| OpenMP, 256 threads, default environment | ~8000 to 9000 |\n| OpenMP, 64 threads | ~7800 |\n\nAt 384^3 the problem no longer fits in the combined L3 and throughput drops to about 1500 MCellUpdates/s, which is the memory bandwidth limit rather than a parallelization issue."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":361,"cache_read_input_tokens":47154,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":361},"output_tokens":765,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bee5fb57-6a3e-4e52-8775-e118ad1de1e4","uuid":"fcf9dbbb-6216-4e9a-befd-f1a15555bf29","timestamp":"2026-10-11T09:31:40.064Z","request_id":"req_011CfvDYjVi7BMKgpfqsGDd6"}
